sloka: जुह्वतश्चापि तत्राग्निं रक्तोष्णीषधराः स्त्रियः।आजग्मुस्तत्र सम्भ्रान्ता राक्षस्यो यत्र रावणिः ।। ६.८०.६ ।।
transliteration: juhvataścāpi tatrāgniṁ raktoṣṇīṣadharāḥ striyaḥ।ājagmustatra sambhrāntā rākṣasyo yatra rāvaṇiḥ ।। 6.80.6 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter, as he went to the place of fire sacrifice, Rakshasa women brought red coloured head dresses to wear (for the priests).
